headline: Tesla robotaxis go driverless in Miami
body: A quiet day. Tesla expanded unsupervised robotaxi service to Miami, its fifth city, a small step up in AI Autonomy that nudges Conquerors and Zookeeper. Robotaxis without safety monitors are a concrete example of AI acting without a human in the loop. Otherwise lines drifted as older stories faded. Horizon Balance: +1.11.
movers_note: No ending moved by as much as 0.05 points (all 0.0 at one decimal); Conquerors and Zookeeper shifted most, by three hundredths, from the Tesla robotaxi story.
coming_up: Tesla targets robotaxi service in a dozen states by year-end
